questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。根据后文提到的“whose dedication inspired me to come up with this expedition”可知，作者完成的是一次前往南极的探险（expedition）。A表示假日，C表示访问，D表示郊游，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(holiday)：语境句：We went on a relaxing holiday to the beach. 固定搭配：on holiday, public holiday
B(expedition)：语境句：The scientists organized an expedition to the Amazon rainforest. 固定搭配：go on an expedition, scientific expedition
C(visit)：语境句：I plan to pay a visit to my former teacher. 固定搭配：pay a visit to, return a visit
D(outing)：语境句：Our school organized a spring outing for the students. 固定搭配：go on an outing, family outing

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。根据前文他们打破了世界速度纪录，故此处意为把之前的最好成绩“缩短”了5天。“cut... off”可表示削减、缩短时间，符合句意。
questions.supplement:
A(cut)：语境句：The new road cuts our journey time in half. 固定搭配：cut down, cut off
B(spent)：语境句：She spent a lot of time reading books. 固定搭配：spend time doing, spend money on
C(kept)：语境句：He kept the secret to himself for years. 固定搭配：keep doing, keep in mind
D(extended)：语境句：The deadline for the project has been extended. 固定搭配：extend the deadline, extend a warm welcome

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词搭配。“make a journey”为固定搭配，意为“进行一次旅行/行程”。其他动词均不符合该固定表达的习惯用法。
questions.supplement:
A(describe)：语境句：Words cannot describe how grateful I am. 固定搭配：describe sth to sb, beyond description
B(make)：语境句：They made a long journey across the desert. 固定搭配：make a journey, make a decision
C(create)：语境句：The artist created a beautiful painting. 固定搭配：create an opportunity, create an atmosphere
D(start)：语境句：We need to start our preparation early. 固定搭配：start to do, start with

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。宾语是a sled(雪橇)，在南极的雪地上前进通常是“拖、拉”雪橇，因此dragging最符合动作逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(providing)：语境句：The hotel is providing excellent service for guests. 固定搭配：provide sth for sb, provide sb with sth
B(driving)：语境句：He was driving a red sports car. 固定搭配：drive a car, drive sb crazy
C(pushing)：语境句：She was pushing a shopping cart in the supermarket. 固定搭配：push forward, push for
D(dragging)：语境句：The boy was dragging his heavy suitcase along the street. 固定搭配：drag one's feet, drag on

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。句意为每天在零下40度“勇敢面对”巨大的逆风。brave在此作动词，意为“勇敢面对（困难或危险）”，非常生动且契合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(explored)：语境句：The researchers explored the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：explore the possibility, explore outer space
B(observed)：语境句：The doctor observed the patient's behavior carefully. 固定搭配：observe the rule, observe sb doing sth
C(braved)：语境句：They braved the heavy rain to attend the meeting. 固定搭配：brave the storm, brave the elements
D(measured)：语境句：The tailor measured me for a new suit. 固定搭配：measure up to, take measures

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词短语辨析。句意为冰缝上的薄冰桥随时可能“崩塌”，把人和雪橇带入深渊。give way意为“崩塌，支撑不住断裂”，完全符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(melt away)：语境句：His anger melted away when she smiled. 固定搭配：melt into, melt down
B(give way)：语境句：The bridge gave way under the weight of the truck. 固定搭配：give way to, give in
C(turn down)：语境句：She turned down the job offer because of the low salary. 固定搭配：turn down the volume, turn out
D(hold back)：语境句：He tried to hold back his tears. 固定搭配：hold back the truth, hold on

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。前文提到遇到一个非凡的人，他的奉献精神“启发/鼓舞”（inspired）了作者发起这次探险。forced强迫，chose选择，均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(forced)：语境句：The bad weather forced them to stay indoors. 固定搭配：force sb to do, be forced to do
B(chose)：语境句：She chose to study medicine at university. 固定搭配：choose from, choice of
C(expected)：语境句：We expected him to arrive on time. 固定搭配：expect sb to do, as expected
D(inspired)：语境句：His speech inspired us to work harder. 固定搭配：inspire sb to do, draw inspiration from

questions.explanation: 本题考察形容词辨析。后文提到这是一个“two-way street”(双向交流的途径)，说明他们建立的这个网站是可以“互动的”（interactive）。
questions.supplement:
A(interactive)：语境句：The museum has interactive exhibits for children. 固定搭配：interactive whiteboard, interactive communication
B(unusual)：语境句：It is unusual for him to be late. 固定搭配：unusual weather, highly unusual
C(familiar)：语境句：Her face seemed familiar to me. 固定搭配：be familiar with, be familiar to
D(temporary)：语境句：He is looking for a temporary job. 固定搭配：temporary accommodation, temporary relief

questions.explanation: 本题考察非谓语动词/动名词辨析。结合紧跟在后面的句子“So we would be blogging to these students...”可知，此处通过“写博客”来将全球的年轻人带入到这场探险中。选项中blogging最符合逻辑呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(blogging)：语境句：She earns a living by blogging about travel. 固定搭配：fashion blogging, live blogging
B(dancing)：语境句：They spent the whole night dancing at the party. 固定搭配：go dancing, dancing club
C(skiing)：语境句：We are going skiing in the Alps this winter. 固定搭配：go skiing, water skiing
D(acting)：语境句：He won an award for his brilliant acting. 固定搭配：acting career, voice acting

questions.explanation: 本题考察介词短语辨析。前句提到“我们给学生写博客记录”，本句说明学生“反过来”问我们问题，体现双向互动过程中的轮换与反馈，因此填In turn（反过来）。
questions.supplement:
A(In time)：语境句：We arrived at the station just in time for the train. 固定搭配：in time, on time
B(In common)：语境句：The two cultures have a lot in common. 固定搭配：have sth in common, in common with
C(In turn)：语境句：Stress causes lack of sleep, which in turn makes stress worse. 固定搭配：take turns, in one's turn
D(In particular)：语境句：I loved the food, in particular the dessert. 固定搭配：anything in particular, in general

questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。结合前面的互动描写（写博客与提问），网站成功充当了一个双向“交流/沟通”（communication）的途径。
questions.supplement:
A(appearance)：语境句：Judging by his appearance, he must be very rich. 固定搭配：make an appearance, physical appearance
B(transportation)：语境句：Public transportation is very convenient in this city. 固定搭配：public transportation, means of transportation
C(performance)：语境句：The band gave an excellent performance last night. 固定搭配：academic performance, live performance
D(communication)：语境句：Good communication is essential in a team. 固定搭配：effective communication, communication skills

questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。经过艰苦卓绝的历程抵达南极点，完成了这件常人看似不可能的事，此时他们互相看着对方，眼神中满是“难以置信”（disbelief）。
questions.supplement:
A(disbelief)：语境句：He stared at the winning lottery ticket in disbelief. 固定搭配：shake one's head in disbelief, beyond belief
B(sadness)：语境句：She could not hide the sadness in her eyes. 固定搭配：a feeling of sadness, deep sadness
C(confusion)：语境句：The new rules caused a lot of confusion. 固定搭配：in confusion, avoid confusion
D(tiredness)：语境句：He collapsed from extreme tiredness. 固定搭配：physical tiredness, mental tiredness

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析及搭配。“set sb doing sth”意为“使某人开始做某事”。紧接的问题“我从这次旅程中收获了什么？”表明作者陷入了“反思/沉思”（reflecting）。
questions.supplement:
A(regretting)：语境句：I am regretting my decision to quit the job. 固定搭配：regret doing sth, regret to say
B(reflecting)：语境句：He spent time reflecting on his past mistakes. 固定搭配：reflect on, set sb reflecting
C(complaining)：语境句：She is always complaining about the weather. 固定搭配：complain about, complain to sb
D(laughing)：语境句：The joke had everyone laughing loudly. 固定搭配：burst out laughing, laugh at

questions.explanation: 本题考察副词辨析。六年前他每天抽一包烟，暗示他当时的生活方式非常不健康、缺乏运动，因此选项中inactively（不活跃地）最符合语境中的对比意义。
questions.supplement:
A(healthily)：语境句：Eating healthily is important for your body. 固定搭配：live healthily, eat healthily
B(wonderfully)：语境句：The party was wonderfully organized. 固定搭配：wonderfully well, do wonderfully
C(inactively)：语境句：Sitting inactively for long hours can harm your health. 固定搭配：live inactively, behave inactively
D(secretly)：语境句：They were secretly married last year. 固定搭配：secretly hope, act secretly

questions.explanation: 本题考察形容词辨析。“be capable of doing sth”为固定搭配，意为“有能力做某事”。对应前文的“将不可能变为可能”，说明我们只要下定决心，就“有能力”完成任何事。
questions.supplement:
A(relieved)：语境句：I was relieved to hear that you arrived safely. 固定搭配：feel relieved, be relieved to hear
B(ashamed)：语境句：He felt ashamed of his rude behavior. 固定搭配：be ashamed of, feel ashamed
C(capable)：语境句：She is a highly capable teacher. 固定搭配：be capable of doing, capable hands
D(unaware)：语境句：He was completely unaware of the danger. 固定搭配：be unaware of, remain unaware

questions.explanation: 空格前有形容词remarkable修饰，故需填名词。deep的名词形式为depth（深度，深厚）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(depth)：语境句：The ocean's depth is difficult to measure accurately. 固定搭配：in depth, the depth of sth。原词deep其它变形：deeply(adv.), deepen(v.)

questions.explanation: 本题考察非限制性定语从句的引导词。逗号隔开了从句和主句，As在此引导非限制性定语从句，意为“正如在生活各方面所反映的那样”。句首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(As)：语境句：As is known to all, regular exercise is good for health. 固定搭配：as is known to all, as is expected

questions.explanation: 主语Traditional Chinese philosophy是单数第三人称，且全段描述客观事实，使用一般现在时。place importance on为固定搭配，意为“重视”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(places)：语境句：Our school places great emphasis on students' mental health. 固定搭配：place importance on, place emphasis on。原词place其它变形：placement(n.), replace(v.)

questions.explanation: Confucianism（儒家思想）与found（创立）之间是逻辑上的动宾关系（被动），故使用过去分词founded作后置定语（等于which was founded）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(founded)：语境句：The organization, founded in 1990, has helped many people. 固定搭配：be founded on/upon, newly founded。原词found其它变形：foundation(n.), founder(n.)

questions.explanation: advocate (提倡) 后习惯接动名词作宾语，即 advocate doing sth，故填 living。
questions.supplement: 正确形(living)：语境句：The doctor advocates eating more vegetables to stay healthy. 固定搭配：advocate doing sth, make a living。原词live其它变形：alive(adj.), lively(adj.)

questions.explanation: provide / offer insights into sth 是固定搭配，意为“对……提供深刻的见解/洞察力”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(into)：语境句：This documentary offers deep insights into animal behavior. 固定搭配：insight into, look into

questions.explanation: means作“方式，手段”解时单复数同形。此处指“一种”表达方式，由于未特指且表泛指单数，故填不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Bicycles are a popular means of transport in this city. 固定搭配：a means of, by means of

questions.explanation: 此处修饰介词短语 due to，需要用副词。part 的副词形式为 partly，意为“部分地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(partly)：语境句：His success was partly due to his hard work. 固定搭配：partly because, be partly responsible for。原词part其它变形：partial(adj.), participate(v.)

questions.explanation: 空格处需填形容词修饰名词 appeal。根据语意（与 common values 并列的经久不衰的吸引力），填入 timeless（永恒的，不受时间影响的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(timeless)：语境句：The classic novel has a timeless appeal to readers of all ages. 固定搭配：timeless beauty, timeless appeal。原词time其它变形：timely(adj.), timing(n.)

questions.explanation: 主语是 China，结合句意“中国处于有利位置以建立桥梁”，应用动词的被动语态 be positioned (to do sth) 来表示状态。陈述现状使用一般现在时。
knowledge_points: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.supplement: 正确形(is positioned)：语境句：The company is well positioned to expand its market globally. 固定搭配：be positioned to do, in a position to do。原词position其它变形：positive(adj.)
